comment: Smogon sample-team thread URLs per format id. Add or correct URLs freely — the scraper visits every listed thread, follows pokepast.es links, and reports per-thread counts. UNVERIFIED seed list: this environment cannot reach smogon.com, so these URLs are best-effort and the first networked run's log is the verification.

tournament.comment: Team-dump threads ({url, format} pins a format for pastes without === headers) and tournament forum listings to walk (UNVERIFIED seed URLs). Paste === headers and replay-link ids attribute formats directly; thread prefixes fall back through the rmt prefixMap.

rmt.comment: RMT forum listings to walk (UNVERIFIED seed URLs, same caveat as above). Threads are attributed to formats via their prefix label; unmapped prefixes are reported by the scraper log so the map can grow.
